subject: Slate Systems vendor enrollment: PO fields, VAT declaration, and EFT mandate
messages:
From: AP Ops <ap-ops@slatesystems.eu>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Andersson <sofia.andersson@slatesystems.eu>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 13:22:00 +0200
Subject: Vendor enrollment: Redwood (next steps and PO field mapping)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for confirming Redwood as an approved vendor for Slate. Our AP team is starting vendor activation and needs the following to create the vendor record and link POs correctly to your invoices: 

- Legal entity name and registered address (exact match to invoice)
- Tax/VAT registration number for invoice validation (EU VAT ID if applicable)
- Preferred remit-to currency and banking info (we accept IBAN + BIC for euro settlements)
- PO reference placement: Slate requires the PO number to appear in the invoice header and the invoice filename in the format PO{number}_Invoice.pdf
- Payment terms: Slate standard is Net45; please confirm whether Redwood will accept or request an exception

We also need you to complete our vendor portal form and return an EFT mandate. I've attached the vendor onboarding checklist. Can you please get us the VAT declaration and EFT mandate signed this week so we can schedule first payment?

Appreciate it — we have a small pilot PoS launch next month and want payments live.

Regards,
AP Ops
Slate Systems

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: AP Ops <ap-ops@slatesystems.eu>
Cc: Sofia Andersson <sofia.andersson@slatesystems.eu>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Redwood (next steps and PO field mapping)

Hi — thanks for the checklist and the clear ask. Quick responses inline: 

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. — 4126 Mission St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94112, USA (this is our U.S. billing entity). If you need an EU-registered entity for local VAT, we can supply Redwood Inference EU Ltd details next business day.
- VAT: Redwood Inference EU Ltd VAT ID: EU123456789 (we'll attach a signed EU VAT self-cert).
- Remit: We prefer EUR payments into our EU bank. Laura (cc'd) is our finance lead and will provide the IBAN/BIC and the completed EFT mandate.
- PO placement: confirmed — we'll ensure the PO number is in the invoice header and the filename format PO{number}_Invoice.pdf for Slate's ingestion. We'll also include the PO in the PDF meta where possible.
- Terms: Redwood is fine with Net45 for the pilot. If the account team needs earlier payment for onboarding services, we can discuss a short-term Net30 for the first invoice.

I'll attach our AP onboarding packet, a completed EU VAT self-cert draft, and a placeholder EFT mandate that Laura will finalize. Monica will monitor DocuSign and ping when the signed copy lands.

Next steps requested of Slate: please confirm the vendor portal URL to submit the onboarding packet (some portals require specific field mapping we may need to mirror), and confirm whether Slate requires a separate remit-to vendor record for Redwood Inference EU Ltd vs Redwood Inference, Inc.

Thanks — Karthik

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.2.pdf, EU_VAT_Self-Certification_2026.pdf, EFT_Mandate_Slate_Signature.docusign.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Andersson <sofia.andersson@slatesystems.eu>, AP Ops <ap-ops@slatesystems.eu>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:14:00 +0100
Subject: Redwood remittance details and VAT guidance

Hi Sofia / AP team — Laura from Finance here. A couple of clarifications to speed the vendor activation: 

1) Bank details (preferred for EUR settlements to Redwood Inference EU Ltd):
   - Account name: Redwood Inference EU Ltd
   - IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
   - BIC/SWIFT: NWBKGB2L
   - Bank: Newbridge Bank (UK) — please note we use this for EUR clearing for EU customers.

2) Invoice routing: Please route invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com (this mailbox is connected to our AP ingestion service). For Slate's end, ensure the invoice PDF name follows PO{number}_Invoice.pdf and the invoice header contains: Invoice number, Invoice date, PO number, Redwood legal entity, and VAT ID.

3) VAT self-cert: We have attached a signed EU VAT self-certification. If Slate requires a supplier-side reverse-charge checkbox or separate reporting, please tell us which field in your portal to populate. Some customers require a "VAT reverse charge" boolean when the buyer is responsible for VAT.

4) EFT/Docusign: Monica is prepared to complete the portal's e-mandate. If Slate uses DocuSign, please send the envelope ID or the portal's e-sign flow. We've included a signed placeholder EFT mandate in case you prefer a PDF upload.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to finalize mapping if helpful — Karthik / Monica, I can join.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EFT_Mandate_Slate_Signature.docusign.pdf, EU_VAT_Self-Certification_2026.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: AP Ops <ap-ops@slatesystems.eu>, Sofia Andersson <sofia.andersson@slatesystems.eu>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 13:08:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Redwood (PO fields, VAT declaration, and EFT mandate)

Thanks — I just uploaded the EFT mandate to DocuSign and completed the signature flow (envelope ID DS-7654321).

A couple of micro-notes from the onboarding checklist experience: 
- Your portal's "company type" dropdown must accept "Subsidiary" — we needed that when adding Redwood Inference EU Ltd as a secondary remit-to.
- For anyone mapping, we included an example invoice sample in the Drive link (same folder as onboarding packet). The sample shows the exact filename and header layout Slate should expect.

If Slate confirms the portal link and the preferred remit vendor record (single vendor with multiple remit-to vs separate vendor records), we can mark the onboarding as complete on our side and await the first PO.

Short answer on timing: once AP confirms the vendor record and the DocuSign is recorded, Slate's first invoice cycles are aligned to Net45 from invoice date; we will submit the pilot invoice next Tuesday.

Best,
Monica
